references.text: Angels play a protective role, which is reflected in how they look upon God's face on behalf of the 'least'.
The importance of not despising or underestimating the small or humble, a theme also addressed in Matthew.
God's care for the small and humble, as reflected in the angels' care in Matthew.
The treatment of the 'least' as a reflection of our treatment of Jesus himself, parallel to the idea of the angels' care for the small.
